config.grain_rationale: One record is one current Australian credit licence issued by ASIC to a licensee. The business participant is the licensee (the holder), so business attributes (legal name, ABN, address) are mapped from the licence-holder columns; the licence number is the record's own identifier, not a business identifier, and licence status/dates describe the licence, not the entity.

record_id.rationale: CRED_LIC_NUM present on every row, 464 distinct among 464 records (100% unique), fixed 6-digit shape. It is the ASIC credit licence number and the stable traceable key.

fields.rationale: Column names the licensee, the legal person to whom the credit licence is issued (publisher: licence name changes follow business register updates). Values are registered-style legal names ending PTY LTD / LIMITED; some rows are individual holders in surname-first form (e.g. 'TAN, JINTANG'), still the holder's legal name rather than a trading name.

CRED_LIC_BN is the licensee's business name, present on 34.5% of rows. Values are short trading-style names ('PLANNING PARTNERS', 'DEFENCE BANK', 'STACKS FINANCE') distinct from the legal-name column.

Mixed ABN/ACN column: 420/464 values are 11 digits and 90.5% of those pass the ABN checksum, so the 11-digit population is an ABN population. The regex pre-filter keeps only 11-digit values so the checksummed abn transform is applied solely to genuine ABN candidates; shorter ACN-shaped values and the '0' placeholder (13 rows) are deliberately left unmapped rather than converted.
100% present with 314 distinct AU suburb/locality values, paired with coherent state and postcode columns.
All 464 values are 1-character AU state abbreviations across 8 distinct values, exactly the state enum vocabulary.
100% present, 100% 4-digit numeric shape, 275 distinct values consistent with AU postcodes.

constants.rationale: ASIC Australian credit licensee register; all states are Australian and every postcode is a 4-digit AU postcode.

unmapped.reason: Constant 'Credit Licence' on all rows - register name, not a business attribute.
The licence's own identifier; used for record_id only, not a business identifier.

Start date of the credit licence, not the entity's registration date; publisher evidence says grant/suspension/cancellation dates concern the licence. Mapping it to entity.date_registered would overstate the claim.
Licence end date, empty on all discovery rows; describes the licence, not the holder's entity claims.
Status of the LICENCE (APPR = approved) on every row, not the legal entity's status. Licence status must not become entity.status.
Australian Financial Services licence number - a different licence regime, not a business identifier in this ontology.
Free-text licence condition/enforcement history (present on 0.2% of rows); concerns the licence, not the legal entity's status.
Latitude coordinate; no coordinate target in the ontology.
Longitude coordinate; no coordinate target in the ontology.
External dispute resolution scheme membership (AFCA/COSL/FOS), a licence-condition attribute, not an entity or address field.
Long free-text description of what the licence authorises; describes the licence scope, not an entity attribute.

config.notes: Tab-delimited UTF-8-BOM text despite the TSV label; 17 columns, header on row 0. CRED_LIC_ABN_ACN is a combined ABN/ACN column: only the 11-digit values are mapped, via an ^\d{11}$ pre-filter plus the checksummed abn transform. The 9-digit population (27 rows) was NOT mapped to entity.acn because no publisher evidence separates ABN from ACN in this column and the column-wide ACN checksum-valid rate is only 6.7%, so claiming those values are ACNs is unverified inference from shape alone - a wrong ABN/ACN mapping is worse than a missing one. entity.status intentionally emits nothing: CRED_LIC_STATUS describes the licence, not the legal entity, and rows with suspension history show licence status cannot establish holder status, so the ontology default of unknown applies. Licence-derived facts (start/end dates, status, authorisation text, EDR scheme, coordinates, AFSL number) are all left unmapped because the grain is the licence, not the entity. Held-out run was clean on every retained rule (0 errors).
